messages:
Priya: Pushed a new iteration of the Rollouts timeline (compact + expanded). Main goals: make rollback quicker, reduce visual noise for long histories, and surface A/B splits without expanding. Figma: https://figma.com/file/efgh (frame: rollout-compact-3)

Theo: Nice direction. Couple of microcopy asks: change \"Start canary\" to \"Start canary (non-blocking)\" and replace \"Abort\" in the inline menu with \"Pause & inspect\" to reduce alarm. :thinking_face:

Noah: Engineering note 30 we can add a pre-fetched metadata payload to the timeline list to avoid N+1 calls when expanding many rows. For pagination use `?before=TIMESTAMP&limit=50`.

Rae (a11y): A11y checklist: 1) timeline row hover state needs 3:1 contrast on background change; 2) all action buttons require accessible names (e.g., `aria-label=\"Rollback version v1.4.2\"`); 3) announce expansions with polite live region. Also consider reducing reliance on color alone for status. :a11y:

Priya: Thanks Rae. For colors I'm proposing pattern + text: e.g., a small outlined flame icon + \"Canary \u2014 20m\". That should help screen reader users and colorblind folks.

Theo: For compact layout, replace full-width bars with 3-segment microbars: succeeded/failed/in-progress, each 24px wide. Add exact percent hover tooltip.

Noah: Can confirm microbars are cheap to render. Please keep the DOM shallow for collapsed rows to help long lists.

Vik: Product ask 3 include a small experiment badge for A/B: `exp:42 70/30`. Clicking it should open the experiment details in a drawer instead of full page.

Priya: Agree on drawer. Also adding a tiny timestamp label (e.g., \"2h ago\") to the right will help scanning.

Rae (a11y): Keyboard flow: ensure the action menu is reachable by Tab and the rollback confirmation modal traps focus and has an accessible cancel. Also ensure live regions announce the result of rollback (success/failure).

Theo: Copy tweak: change rollback CTA from \"Rollback now\" to \"Initiate rollback\" and provide an inline undo for 30s after action. People often mis-click.

Noah: Backend can support undo by keeping a reversal job for 30s and exposing `/deployments/:id/undo` endpoint. Logically simple.

Priya: UX question 3 should failed deployments remain collapsed or auto-expand? Product prefers auto-expand to surface errors, but that can be noisy. Thoughts?

Vik: Auto-expand only for the first failed item in view, and show a short error summary inline with a link to logs. That balances visibility and noise.

Rae (a11y): When auto-expanding, move focus to the error summary so screen reader users hear it immediately. Use `role=alert` for critical errors.

pm-bot: New screenshot uploaded: https://assets.company.com/rollout-compact-3.png

Priya: Great feedback. I'll iterate: microbars + percent tooltip, flame icon + label, drawer for experiments, \"Initiate rollback\" copy, 30s undo hint, focus handling for errors, and post a new frame tomorrow AM. :zap:
